notes: B-90 (a) (2026-10-29). CR 601.2g / 605.3a: a player may activate mana abilities while paying. Seat 1 has no floating mana on seat 0's turn (pools empty as each step and phase ends, CR 500.5), so it pays Cancel's {1}{U}{U} by tapping three of its four Islands (a minimal set, never all) and counters the Watchdog.
